title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors allows a plaintext HTTP parent
description: Allowing an http: parent in frame-ancestors means the framing page can be modified in transit, so the composition the user sees is chosen by the network, not the site. HTTPS on the framed page does not repair a plaintext parent.
applicability: Responses that send Content-Security-Policy with frame-ancestors on authenticated pages.
risk: A network attacker rewrites the plaintext parent, places the authenticated frame where they choose, and captures clicks meant for other controls.
